race.comment: STUNTMAN (6) resumed in a deeper maiden at Bendigo over 1300m, in the market there but just battling away to finish seventh. That was his first go on rain affected ground having shown ability last time in, onto synthetic here with added fitness can see sharp improvement. AURUM STAR (10) ran a good race on debut as a $20 chance at Swan Hill to grab a narrow third. Tough draw here but have to respect. RICH KING (5) resumes having show ability last time in, the form out of those races has worked out well for this, go close. SCAROLE (12) worked home okay on debut at Geelong and should be an improver in this.
